lines.text: Meet Glow Ops: the AI platform that runs your beauty brand.
Three pillars, one place. A Personalized Beauty Advisor for your shoppers. Sales Intelligence, and Forecasting and Demand Signal, for your team.
Pillar one: the Personalized Beauty Advisor. This is Rupa, a demo beauty store. One line of code adds the advisor.
Meet Vera, the store's AI beauty advisor.
Shoppers tap Scan for a quick, three-pose face scan. No app to install.
Face the camera. Turn right. Turn left. Each photo is taken hands-free, the moment the pose is right.
In seconds, AI reads her colours, face shape and skin.
Her colour season is called out, True Summer, with the palette that flatters her.
Her face shape, with the makeup looks that suit it best.
And a skin reading, area by area: hydration, texture, pores.
Then she simply asks for a lipstick, and real shades from the catalog appear, matched to her season, with real prices.
Ask anything, like a hydrating serum. Product cards show up in seconds, ready to shop.
Pillar two: Sales Intelligence. Inside the Glow Ops dashboard, your team asks about sales in plain language.
Why did the nine-nine sale drop? It finds the real cause in your own data: the ad budget was cut by sixty percent. Twenty-three units sold, against eighty-seven at eight-eight.
Ask what to do for eleven-eleven, and you get concrete steps, grounded in what actually worked at ten-ten.
Pillar three: Forecasting and Demand Signal. It opens with today's top insight, written by AI from your data.
Demand signals for every product are tracked against a forecast baseline, so you catch a surge early.
The event and promo planner puts every campaign on one timeline, with deadlines and results for each.
And promo-code attribution shows which campaigns actually bring shoppers in.
Glow Ops. Sales Intelligence, Forecasting and Demand Signal, and a Personalized Beauty Advisor, all in one place.
Run your beauty brand with AI.
